title: API session in the Hub: one reused client per calling device, no video

before.done_when: the first API call from a device adds one Hub client for it that starts no capture session and is reused by later calls; held buttons and keys stay down between calls, so a drag can span calls; after API_IDLE_SECONDS (120) with no call, or on Disconnect, the client is removed and releaseAll runs; its view only comes from the Allow Claude setting (Q answer), not from a message; SelfTest covers reuse, expiry with release, and view only refusing control

done_when: the first API call from a device adds one Hub client for it that starts no capture session and is reused by later calls; held buttons and keys stay down between calls, so a drag can span calls; after API_IDLE_SECONDS (120) with no call, or on Disconnect, the client is removed and releaseAll runs; its view only follows the Allow Claude setting (Q-1), not a message; SelfTest covers reuse, expiry with release, and view only refusing control
body: Hub.add starts capture when it adds the first client and Hub.remove ends it and releases input, so a client per request would start and stop capture on every click and break drags. This step adds a Hub entry for API clients that skips startSession and keeps state until it expires.
